title: Ember and Storm's Tree Game
titleZh: Ember 与 Storm 的树上游戏
statementMd:
Ember and Storm play a game. First, Ember picks a labelled tree $*T*$ of $*n*$ vertices, such that the degree of every vertex is at most $*d*$. Then, Storm picks two distinct vertices $*u*$ and $*v*$ in this tree and writes down the labels of the vertices in the path from $*u*$ to $*v*$ in a sequence $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}... *a*_{*k*}$. Finally, Ember picks any index $*i*$ ($1 ≤ *i* < *k*$) in the array. Now he performs one of the following two operations exactly once:

- flip the subrange $[*i* + 1, *k*]$ and add $*a*_{*i*}$ to it. After this, the sequence becomes $*a*_{1}, ... *a*_{*i*}, *a*_{*k*} + *a*_{*i*}, *a*_{*k* - 1} + *a*_{*i*}, ... *a*_{*i* + 1} + *a*_{*i*}$
- negate the subrange $[*i* + 1, *k*]$ and add $*a*_{*i*}$ to it. i.e., the array becomes $*a*_{1}, ... *a*_{*i*}, - *a*_{*i* + 1} + *a*_{*i*}, - *a*_{*i* + 2} + *a*_{*i*}, ... - *a*_{*k*} + *a*_{*i*}$

Ember wins if the array is monotonically increasing or decreasing after this. Otherwise Storm wins.

The game can be described by the tuple $(*T*, *u*, *v*, *i*, *op*)$ where $*op*$ is «flip» or «negate» depending on the action Ember chose in the last turn. Find the number of tuples that can occur if Ember and Storm play optimally. When they play optimally, if there are multiple moves by which they are guaranteed to win, then they may play any of the winning moves. Otherwise, if someone loses no matter what they play, then they may play any of the possible moves.

Report the answer modulo $*m*$.

## Input

The input consists of a single line containing three integers $*n*$, $*d*$ and $*m*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 200, 1 ≤ *d* < *n*, 1 ≤ *m* ≤ 2·10^{9}$).

## Output

Print a single number  — the number of possible tuples if Ember and Storm play as described, modulo $*m*$.

## Note

In the first sample case, there is only one possible tree. There are two possible paths, $1$ to $2$ and $2$ to $1$. For both paths, $*i*$ can only be $1$, and $*op*$ can take both possibilities. Therefore, the answer is $4$.

In the second sample, there are no possible trees.

In the third sample, there are three possible trees.
statementZhMd:
Ember 和 Storm 玩一个游戏。首先，Ember 选择一棵有标号的树 $*T*$，它有 $*n*$ 个顶点，且每个顶点的度数都不超过 $*d*$。然后，Storm 选择树中的两个不同顶点 $*u*$ 和 $*v*$，并将从 $*u*$ 到 $*v*$ 的路径上各顶点的标号按顺序写入序列 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}... *a*_{*k*}$。最后，Ember 在数组中选择任意一个下标 $*i*$（$1 ≤ *i* < *k*$）。现在，他恰好执行以下两种操作之一：

- 翻转子区间 $[*i* + 1, *k*]$，并将 $*a*_{*i*}$ 加到其中。操作后，序列变为 $*a*_{1}, ... *a*_{*i*}, *a*_{*k*} + *a*_{*i*}, *a*_{*k* - 1} + *a*_{*i*}, ... *a*_{*i* + 1} + *a*_{*i*}$
- 将子区间 $[*i* + 1, *k*]$ 取相反数，并将 $*a*_{*i*}$ 加到其中。也就是说，数组变为 $*a*_{1}, ... *a*_{*i*}, - *a*_{*i* + 1} + *a*_{*i*}, - *a*_{*i* + 2} + *a*_{*i*}, ... - *a*_{*k*} + *a*_{*i*}$

如果操作后数组单调递增或单调递减，则 Ember 获胜；否则 Storm 获胜。

可以用元组（$*T*, *u*, *v*, *i*, *op*$）描述这场游戏，其中根据 Ember 在最后一回合选择的操作，$*op*$ 为 «flip» 或 «negate»。假设 Ember 和 Storm 都采取最优策略，求可能出现的元组数量。当双方采取最优策略时，如果有多个能够保证获胜的操作，他们可以选择其中任意一个获胜操作。否则，如果无论采取何种操作都会输，那么他们可以选择任意一个可能的操作。

请输出答案对 $*m*$ 取模后的结果。

## 输入格式

输入包含一行，三个整数 $*n*$、$*d*$ 和 $*m*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 200$，$1 ≤ *d* < *n*$，$1 ≤ *m* ≤ 2·10^{9}$）。

## 输出格式

输出一个数——如果 Ember 和 Storm 按照上述方式进行游戏，可能出现的元组数量对 $*m*$ 取模后的结果。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，只有一棵可能的树。可能的路径有两条，分别是从 $1$ 到 $2$ 以及从 $2$ 到 $1$。对于这两条路径，$*i*$ 都只能取 $1$，而 $*op*$ 可以取两种可能的值。因此，答案为 $4$。

在第二个样例中，不存在可能的树。

在第三个样例中，共有三棵可能的树。
